title: DeployBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Research Artifact Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2606.05238v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents have made rapid progress on software engineering and ML research tasks, but these advances often assume access to a working runnable environment. For research artifacts released alongside published papers, setting up such an environment from a fresh machine remains a major bottleneck. Existing environment setup benchmarks do not cover the full scope of research-artifact deployment, which involves multi-language toolchains, system-level dependencies beyond containers (e.g., GPU/CUDA and kernel configurations), and legacy artifact compatibility. We introduce DeployBench, a multi-domain benchmark of 51 research-artifact deployment tasks spanning AI/ML, computer systems, and scientific computing, covering all these dimensions. Each task is verified by a hidden pipeline that executes the paper's designated experiment and checks its outputs. Evaluating five state-of-the-art LLMs with OpenHands yields pass-rates from 7.8%-51.0%.

translated_title: DeployBench：面向研究工件部署的大语言模型智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在软件工程和机器学习研究任务上进展迅速，但这些进展通常假设已经存在一个可运行的工作环境。对于随已发表论文发布的研究工件而言，从一台全新的机器上搭建这样的环境仍然是一个主要瓶颈。现有的环境搭建基准无法覆盖研究工件部署的全部范围，后者涉及多语言工具链、容器之外的系统级依赖（例如 GPU/CUDA 和内核配置），以及遗留工件的兼容性问题。我们提出了 DeployBench，这是一个多领域基准，包含 51 项研究工件部署任务，横跨 AI/ML、计算机系统和科学计算领域，并覆盖了上述所有维度。每个任务都通过一个隐藏的流水线进行验证，该流水线会执行论文指定的实验并检查其输出结果。使用 OpenHands 对五个最先进的大语言模型进行评估，通过率仅为 7.8%–51.0%。
tldr: 提出了首个覆盖多语言工具链、容器外系统级依赖（如GPU/CUDA）及遗留工件兼容性的多领域基准 DeployBench（包含51项研究工件部署任务），评估显示最先进LLM智能体的通过率仅为7.8%–51.0%，表明研究工件部署仍是当前智能体能力的重大短板。
en_tdlr: DeployBench introduces a 51-task multi-domain benchmark covering multi-language toolchains, system-level dependencies beyond containers, and legacy artifact compatibility for research artifact deployment, revealing that state-of-the-art LLM agents achieve only 7.8%-51.0% pass rates.
